problem_statement: Design a smart battery management system for second-life EV batteries in home storage
common_failure_points: Poor thermal management leading to localized runaway; Inaccurate SoH estimation for unmatched cells
edge_cases: Grid blackouts during peak summer causing 100% discharge demand; Mismatched chemistries triggering balancing failure

problem_statement: Build an IoT-based crop disease prediction system using edge AI
common_failure_points: Sensors degrading rapidly in harsh weather; High latency in cloud inference due to poor rural internet
edge_cases: Complete loss of connectivity for 48 hours during monsoon; Extreme temperature swings giving false positives on humidity sensors

problem_statement: Develop a decentralized micro-lending platform for unbanked populations
common_failure_points: High gas fees during network congestion; Lack of offline transaction support
edge_cases: Users losing access to private keys; Sybil attacks mimicking thousands of fake borrowers

problem_statement: Create a real-time remote patient monitoring system for post-op care
common_failure_points: Data privacy breaches; High false-alarm rates causing alarm fatigue for nurses
edge_cases: Wearable device battery dying unexpectedly during a critical vitals spike; Bluetooth interference in crowded hospital wards

problem_statement: Implement an AI-driven traffic light optimization system
common_failure_points: Cameras failing during heavy fog/rain; High latency in processing video feeds at the edge
edge_cases: Emergency vehicles blocked due to system failing to prioritize sirens; Complete network outage causing all lights to default to red

problem_statement: Develop a decentralized peer-to-peer energy trading platform for microgrids
common_failure_points: Smart contract vulnerabilities; Failure to handle rapid fluctuations in solar output
edge_cases: A sudden surge in trading volume crashing the local node; Physical grid disconnection causing settlement mismatch
